profile.name: Ion Beam Applications SA
profile.summary: Ion Beam Applications SA designs, produces, and markets solutions for cancer diagnosis and treatments, serious illnesses, and industrial applications in Belgium, the United States, China, Germany, and India. It operates through four segments, Clinical Proton Therapy; Clinical Dosimetry; IBA Technologies; and IBA Corporate. The company develops ConformalFLASH, a novel technique using the proton Bragg peak; DynamicARC, a technique that allows dynamic spot scanning irradiation and energy switching while the gantry is rotating; Proteus ONE, a compact proton therapy system transforming cancer treatment; Proteus PLUS, a proton therapy solution for cancer centers; and dosimetry solutions that includes radiation therapy; medical imaging; and QUASAR that offers a portfolio of sophisticated phantoms supporting MR guided radiation therapy, motion management, surface guided radiation therapy, geometric distortion analysis, and machine targeting solutions. It also offers radio pharma solutions, including radioisotopes, cyclotrons, and radiochemistry, as well as other integrated and industrial solutions, and services. In addition, the company is involved in construction of proton therapy, and other accelerators equipment and installation services; and operation and maintenance services, as well as sales a license for intellectual property. The company has strategic research and development partnership with SCK CEN, a Belgian nuclear research center focusing on the development of Actinium-225, a radioactive isotope for the treatment of cancer. Ion Beam Applications SA was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Louvain-la-Neuve, Belgium.
profile.summary_fr: Ion Beam Applications SA conçoit, produit et commercialise des solutions pour le diagnostic et le traitement du cancer, les maladies graves et les applications industrielles en Belgique, aux États-Unis, en Chine, en Allemagne et en Inde. Il opère à travers quatre segments, la protonthérapie clinique, la dosimétrie clinique, IBA Technologies et IBA Corporate. La société développe ConformalFLASH, une nouvelle technique utilisant le pic de Bragg de proton; DynamicARC, une technique qui permet l'irradiation par balayage dynamique et la commutation d'énergie pendant que le portique tourne; Proteus ONE, un système de protonthérapie compact transformant le traitement du cancer; Proteus PLUS, une solution de protonthérapie pour les centres de cancérologie; et des solutions de dosimétrie comprenant la radiothérapie; imagerie médicale; et QUASAR
